title: 马来西亚 Langkawi 兰卡威最详细攻略！【4天3夜 旅游攻略 】
author: Jason The Pharmacist

cues.t: Pro tips and guide for Langkawi, Malaysia
cues.r: 兰卡威旅游攻略及实用贴士

cues.t: Let me take you on a tour of Langkawi
at the lowest prices
cues.r: 最优惠的价格畅游兰卡威！

cues.t: Langkawi is the largest island groups in Malaysia
cues.r: 兰卡威是马来西亚最大的岛群，由

cues.t: consists of a total of 99 islands
It is a popular tourist destination that offers
cues.r: 这里是热门的旅游胜地，提供

cues.t: mountain climbing
water sports
off-road adventures
more exciting adventures
and even with duty-free chocolates and alcohol
cues.r: 甚至还有免税的巧克力和酒水，

cues.t: you could find anything here！
cues.r: 您几乎可以在这里找到任何想买的东西！

cues.t: There are two ways to get to Langkawi
cues.r: 前往兰卡威有两种方式：

cues.t: either by plane or by boat
there is no public transportation available
highly recommend you rent a car
as you could go anywhere you wish
cues.r: 这样您就可以自由自在地探索任何想去的地方。来到

cues.t: free and easy
explore anywhere you like
cues.r: 探索任何你喜欢的地方

cues.t: When you are in Langkawi
be sure to visit the Eagle Square for an epic selfie
cues.r: 一定要去鹰广场，在那里您可以拍一张史诗级的自拍，那里有

cues.t: amazing piece of eagle statue right
cues.r: 一座令人惊叹的雄鹰雕像。

cues.t: ‘Langkawi’ comes from the Malay words for eagle
cues.r: “兰卡威”这个名字源于马来语，意为“鹰”（Lang）

cues.t: and reddish-brown
referring to this type of eagle mainly found here
cues.r: 指的是这里主要栖息的这种鹰。如果您

cues.r: 想欣赏整个岛屿的360度全景，

cues.t: must ride the Skycab, Malaysia's highest cable car
cues.r: 一定要乘坐马来西亚最高的缆车——空中缆车（Skycab），

cues.t: to the peak of the 703-meter mountain
there’s an Oriental Village at the mountain base
cues.r: 山脚下有一个东方村，您可以先逛逛，

before you reach the SkyCab ticket counter

cues.t: I highly recommend buying the
Langkawi Klook Pass
It offers seven different attractions
cues.r: 它包含七个不同的景点，

cues.t: including SkyCab, Sea Aquarium
cues.r: 包括空中缆车和海洋水族馆。

cues.t: I bought the 4 attractions-pass
cues.r: 我购买了包含四个景点的通票，

cues.t: Cost RM120 per person
If you would buy these tickets individually
cues.r: 如果单独购买这些景点的门票，

cues.t: Total would hit RM220
Klook Pass could save you up to 55%
cues.r: 通票可以为您节省高达55%的费用。

cues.r: 我到达空中缆车售票处后，立即

Using QR code shown in phone
cues.r: 使用手机上的二维码兑换了门票，

cues.t: It's very convenient
You don’t have to book in advance
If weather was nice

Once reach the top
You could see the Sky Bridge
It is the world's largest curved suspension bridge

cues.t: You could walk down the hill to reach it
cues.r: 您可以步行下山到达桥边。

cues.t: In 10-min time
elderly people or children can take
the sky glide to go up the mountain
which costs 6 Malaysian Ringgit per way
cues.r: 单程费用为6马币，只需10分钟。

cues.t: dont forgot to take selfie here too
First mountain, next would be sea adventures
cues.r: 第一个山，下一个是海上探险。千万

cues.t: Don’t miss out the Langkawi
Island Hopping tour
There’s low tide in the morning
All boats are stuck on the shore
Nevermind
Switch to another departure port
Hop on and here we sail
First island is Pulau Beras Basah
cues.r: 第一个岛屿是湿沙岛（Pulau Beras Basah），

cues.t: Low tide here as well
A lot of people were busy exploring
I joined them too
A lot of corals
Shockingly big sea cucumber
Spot a hermit crab too
First time in my life
Encounter so many eagles
Right here in Pulau Singa Besar
cues.r: 在雄鹰岛（Pulau Singa Besar）遇到了这么多老鹰！

cues.t: Tour guide will throw chicken skin to the sea
cues.r: 导游会把鸡皮扔进海里。

cues.t: Eagle’s eye sight is 6x better than human
cues.r: 老鹰的视力是人类的6倍！

cues.t: Quickly spot the chicken skin
Aim, swoop, catch!
There are two main species
The larger white eagle
And smaller but more impressive-looking brown eagle
cues.r: 和体型较小但外形更令人印象深刻的棕鹰。

cues.t: Does it look like a lying pregnant woman?
cues.r: 它看起来像躺着的孕妇吗？

cues.t: That’s the famous Pregnant Maiden Island
cues.r: 这就是著名的孕妇岛，岛上

cues.t: It has the largest lake in Langkawi
cues.r: 有兰卡威最大的湖泊，就

cues.t: Right here in middle of sea.
You could try kayaking, swim or even sunbathing here
cues.r: 您可以在这里尝试皮划艇、游泳甚至晒日光浴。

cues.t: Speaking of beaches,
Pantai Chenang is definitely not to be missed.
cues.r: 珍南海滩绝对不容错过。

cues.t: Its sand is really fine and soft.
cues.r: 这里的沙子非常细腻柔软。

cues.t: Wow!
It's super smooth.
Don't miss the fire show at Kalut Bar at night.
cues.r: 晚上不要错过卡鲁特酒吧的火舞表演。

cues.t: Just order a cocktail and stay here all night,
cues.r: 点一杯鸡尾酒，在这里待上一整晚，

cues.t: enjoying this wonderful fire show.
cues.r: 欣赏这场精彩的火焰表演。

cues.t: If you want to experience some more exciting outdoor activities in Langkawi,
cues.r: 如果你想在兰卡威体验更多刺激的户外活动，

cues.t: you can go to Langkawi Adventure & Xtreme Park.
cues.r: 可以去兰卡威探险极限公园。

cues.t: With a Klook Pass ticket,
cues.r: 使用 Klook Pass 门票，

cues.t: you can experience six activities.
If that's not exciting enough for you,
cues.r: 如果你觉得这还不够刺激，

cues.t: then you must try Langkawi Skytrex Adventure,
cues.r: 那么你一定要去兰卡威空中滑索探险，

cues.t: which has the longest Flying Fox in northern Malaysia.
cues.r: 那里有马来西亚北部最长的滑索。

cues.t: You will receive simple safety training and guidance at first,
cues.r: 首先你会接受简单的安全培训和指导，

cues.t: then you'll be on your own.
cues.r: 之后你就得自己摸索了。

cues.t: Pose for the coolest picture!
cues.r: 摆个酷炫的姿势拍张美照！

The largest aquarium in Malaysia is also here in Langkawi,
cues.r: 马来西亚最大的水族馆也位于兰卡威，

cues.t: with over 4,000 species of creatures,
and many other attractions such as the Crocodile Farm
cues.r: 还有许多其他景点，如鳄鱼养殖场

cues.t: and KILIM Mangrove Forest waiting for you to explore.
cues.r: 和吉林红树林等着您来探索。还有基林红树林等着你去探索。

cues.t: With so many duty-free shops in Langkawi,
cues.r: 兰卡威有这么多免税店，

cues.t: which one should you go to?
If you want to buy chocolates,
I personally recommend Coco Valley next to the aquarium,
cues.r: 我个人推荐水族馆旁边的 Coco Valley，

cues.t: or TS Duty Free.
They have a wide selection of chocolates,
cues.r: 他们家的巧克力种类繁多，

cues.t: and the prices are relatively cheap.
After seeing all of this,
are you itching to go to Langkawi too?
cues.r: 你是不是也想去兰卡威了？

cues.t: Don't hesitate any longer!
Just go!!
I'm Jason,
see you next time.
